notes.craft: Ring Jacket's tailoring is made in its own Kaizuka (Osaka) factory, and its jacket PDPs say Made in Japan. But the site also sells a large Ring Jacket Napoli line (about 117 items: shirts, trousers, ties, knitwear) whose PDPs say Made in Italy, with no maker named. Owned making covers the core category (tailoring), not the whole range: a 4.

cities: No store of its own in the US · no US site; its own site ships from Japan · also through independent menswear shops

craft_evidence.owned_d: Kaizuka factory, Osaka (Ring Jacket's own, 'directly managed', opened 1957 per Hidetoshi Sasamoto interview on lundochlund.com; expanded twice). Company page (ringjacket.co.jp/f/company) states 自社工場による一貫生産体制 (integrated production in its own factory), 103 employees, but does not name the plant. Press (imn.jp) describes the Kaizuka plant making suits with extensive hand stitching. Covers tailoring; the site gives no evidence it makes the Ring Jacket Napoli line (shirts, trousers, ties, much knitwear), which PDPs say is made in Italy.
craft_evidence.countries: Japan 3/8 own-brand (2 jackets, 1 camel knit); Italy 5/8 own-brand (2 Napoli shirts, Napoli trousers, wool-cashmere knit, Napoli tie). Imports also state country (Gaziano & Girling shoe: England; Moncao trousers: Romania). Sample of 10 PDPs: jackets, knits, shirts, trousers, tie, shoes.
